title: Pullback and symmetry of supported Kummer cup products
statement:
Fix the finite datum $k,\ell,E,n,A=A_{E,n}$ and twists $A(r)$ of [def-pur-conventions], for every $n\geq1$. Use the Kummer classes $\kappa_X(u)$ with arbitrary coefficient index specified in [def-pur-frame-class], the localization boundaries of [thm-pur-with-support-exactness], and the supported tensor-morphism cup product of [def-pur-supported-cup]. On small pro-etale sites the latter means the same tensor-morphism formula with constant coefficients, as in the frame-class definition; on small etale sites use its ordinary etale construction. For every morphism $v:X'\to X$ of $k$-schemes (no finiteness or separatedness hypothesis) and every closed $C\hookrightarrow X$ [def-weil-closed-immersion], with $C'=X'\times_X C$, there are canonical pullback maps
$$v^*:H^a_C(X,A(r))\longrightarrow H^a_{C'}(X',A(r)).$$
They preserve identities and compositions, commute with restriction to the open complements and the connecting homomorphisms in the localization sequences, and agree with ordinary pullback when the support is all of $X$. For units $u,w$ on $X$, the concrete Kummer class satisfies
$$\kappa_X(uw)=\kappa_X(u)+\kappa_X(w),\qquad v^*\kappa_X(u)=\kappa_{X'}(v^*u).$$
For closed $C,D\hookrightarrow X$ and classes $\alpha\in H^a_C(X,A(r))$, $\beta\in H^b_D(X,A(s))$, supported cup products are bilinear and associative, and satisfy
$$v^*(\alpha\cup\beta)=v^*\alpha\cup v^*\beta,\qquad \alpha\cup\beta=(-1)^{ab}\beta\cup\alpha.$$
In the last equation use the symmetry of the supports $C\times_XD\cong D\times_XC$ and the canonical symmetry $A(r)\otimes_A A(s)\cong A(s)\otimes_A A(r)$ followed by the multiplication identification with $A(r+s)$. All assertions hold for both sites, and their canonical etale-to-pro-etale comparison identifies these operations. No invertibility of a purity or exceptional base-change map, nor a Cartier hypothesis on $C,D$ or their pullbacks, is assumed.
